pairs.locus: Ecclesiasticus 33,7-8 (quoted in Summa Theologiae Ia q.47 a.2 sed contra)
pairs.question: Quare dies diem superat, et iterum lux lucem, et annus annum, sol solem?
pairs.derivation: From the 'Sed contra' of Article 2 (line 52), Aquinas quotes Eccli. 33,7-8 verbatim. It is a genuine direct interrogative (Quare...?) immediately followed by its own answer in the same scriptural quotation. The framing 'Sed contra est quod dicitur Eccli. 33,7-8:' is dropped as speech-tag/citation narration. Question ends at the '?'; answer is the full sentence 'A Domini scientia separata sunt.' which directly answers the why-question. Nothing interior was ellipted.
